title: Efficient GMM and Weighting Matrix under Misspecification
abstract: arXiv:2605.04961v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper develops efficient GMM estimation under misspecified moment conditions. The influence function of the standard GMM estimator under misspecification depends on both the moment conditions and their Jacobian, motivating a new class of estimators based on augmented, recentered moment conditions. Standard GMM is a special case and generally suboptimal. By optimally weighting the augmented system, we obtain a misspecification-efficient (ME) estimator with the smallest asymptotic variance for the same GMM estimand. In linear models, its asymptotic variance takes the textbook form $(G'W^{*}G)^{-1}$, where $W^{*}$ is the inverse variance of the residualized moments after projection on the Jacobian $G$. We propose a feasible bootstrap estimator, which is a misspecification-robust and efficient version of the Hall and Horowitz (1996) bootstrap GMM estimator. translated_title: 误设情形下的高效GMM与加权矩阵
translated_abstract: 本文在矩条件误设的情形下发展了高效GMM估计方法。在误设情形下，标准GMM估计量的影响函数同时依赖于矩条件及其雅可比矩阵，由此引出一类基于增广、重新中心化矩条件的新估计量。标准GMM是该类估计量的一个特例，且通常并非最优。通过对增广系统进行最优加权，我们得到了一个误设高效（ME）估计量，其针对同一GMM估计目标具有最小的渐近方差。在线性模型中，其渐近方差呈现教科书式的 $(G'W^{*}G)^{-1}$ 形式，其中 $W^{*}$ 是矩条件向雅可比矩阵 $G$ 投影后的残差化矩的方差倒数。我们提出了一个可行的bootstrap估计量，它是Hall和Horowitz（1996）bootstrap GMM估计量的误设稳健且高效的版本。最后，我们在某一类备择假设上建立了一致局部渐近极小极大界。
tldr: 本文针对矩条件误设的情形，通过最优加权增广再中心化矩条件提出了具有最小渐近方差的误设高效（ME）GMM估计量，并给出其误设稳健高效的bootstrap版本。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a misspecification-efficient (ME) GMM estimator that achieves the smallest asymptotic variance under misspecified moments by optimally weighting augmented, recentered moment conditions, together with a misspecification-robust and efficient bootstrap version.
